name: strong-note-walking-and-meds
input: {"note": "Arrived 8:00, left 12:00. Mr. Whitfield took his 9 am medications from the marked organizer while I watched. Breakfast at 8:30 was oatmeal with banana, fully eaten, with 8 oz of water. Toward his walking goal we walked 12 minutes to the corner and back with the rolling walker, no rests needed. No pain reported. He was reading the paper when I left.", "goals": ["Walk ten minutes each day with the rolling walker", "Take morning medications as scheduled"]}
